title: desmazeria loliacea
intro: Desmazeria loliacea, commonly known as Loliopsis or Desma, is a species of flowering plant in the family Poaceae. It is a perennial grass native to the Mediterranean region, valued for its medicinal properties and health benefits. The plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, including digestive issues and respiratory problems, due to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Desmazeria loliacea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
